scope: Procurement blind pilot target selection and freeze readiness.
freeze_requirements: target contains at least one included case type
included and excluded case types are disjoint
included plus excluded case types exactly cover the Rule Pack engine baseline
every excluded case type has a non-empty reason
every declared family with zero engine case types is explicitly excluded with a non-empty reason
every included case type has complete provenance
no unsupported family remains inside the target
Provenance Matrix blind target exactly matches the Rule Pack blind target
blind eligibility is recomputed rather than trusted from stored data
Rule Pack and Provenance Matrix internal versions match the versions supplied to freeze

invariants.statement: The Rule Pack is the single normative source of blind scope.
Provenance qualification and blind scope are independent axes.
An excluded incomplete rule remains visible but does not block blind readiness.
An included incomplete rule always blocks blind readiness.
A calibration-provisional target can never be frozen for blind evaluation.
The freeze validator independently recomputes readiness and rejects inconsistent declarations.
Historical v1 Rule Pack and Provenance Matrix semantics are not rewritten by v2.
